```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

## Get latest global cancer deaths by cause ----
gbd_latest <- gbd_mertic %>%
  filter(
    location == "Global",
    sex == "Both",
    age == "All ages",
    metric == "Number",
    measure == "Deaths"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%       
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    cause,
    gbd_year = year,
    deaths = val
  )

## Summarise clinical trials by cancer type
clinic_by_cancer <- clinic %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition_clean)) %>% 
  group_by(Condition_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials    = n_distinct(TrialID),
    total_target = sum(target_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Join trials
cancer_joined <- clinic_by_cancer %>%
  inner_join(gbd_latest, by = c("Condition_clean" = "cause")) %>%
  mutate(
    trials_per_100k_deaths = n_trials / (deaths / 1e5),
    target_per_death       = total_target / deaths
  )



```
```{r}
ggplot(cancer_joined,
       aes(x = deaths, y = n_trials, label = Condition_clean)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(check_overlap = TRUE, vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title    = "Clinical trials vs global cancer deaths by cancer type",
    subtitle = paste0("Latest GBD year: ", paste(unique(cancer_joined$gbd_year), collapse = ", ")),
    x = "Global deaths (log scale)",
    y = "Number of clinical trials (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
clinic_by_cancer <- clinic %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition_clean)) %>%
  group_by(Condition_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials     = n_distinct(TrialID),
    total_target = sum(target_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(trial_share = n_trials / sum(n_trials))



make_joined_df <- function(measure_name) {
  gbd_latest <- gbd_mertic %>%
    filter(
      measure  == measure_name,
      location == "Global",
      sex      == "Both",
      age      == "All ages",
      metric   == "Number"
    ) %>%
    group_by(cause) %>%
    filter(year == max(year)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(cause, val)

  gbd_latest <- gbd_latest %>%
    mutate(burden_share = val / sum(val))

  clinic_by_cancer %>%
    inner_join(gbd_latest, by = c("Condition_clean" = "cause")) %>%
    mutate(
      over_rep = trial_share > burden_share   # TRUE = green, FALSE = red
    )
}



make_plot <- function(measure_name, title_suffix) {
  df <- make_joined_df(measure_name)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = burden_share, y = trial_share)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(color = over_rep, size = n_trials), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = Condition_clean),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,   
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.color = "grey60"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "red", "TRUE" = "darkgreen"),
      labels = c("Underrepresented", "Overrepresented"),
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      x = paste0(title_suffix, " share"),
      y = "Clinical trial share",
      title = paste("Clinical trial share vs", title_suffix, "by cancer type")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}




p_deaths <- make_plot("Deaths", "death")
p_dalys  <- make_plot("DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years)", "DALY")
p_prev   <- make_plot("Prevalence", "prevalence")
p_inc    <- make_plot("Incidence", "incidence")

p_deaths
p_dalys
p_prev
p_inc

ggsave("../Result/trials_vs_deaths.png",    p_deaths, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Result/trials_vs_dalys.png",     p_dalys,  width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Result/trials_vs_prevalence.png",p_prev,   width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../Result/trials_vs_incidence.png", p_inc,    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Bar

```{r}

## DALYs by cancer type (latest year, global, both sexes, all ages)
gbd_dalys <- gbd_mertic %>%
  filter(
    measure  == "DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years)",
    location == "Global",
    sex      == "Both",
    age      == "All ages",
    metric   == "Number"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cause, dalys = val)

## Clinical trials by cancer type ----
clinic_sum <- clinic %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition_clean)) %>%
  group_by(Condition_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials      = n_distinct(TrialID),
    total_target  = sum(target_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Join DALYs + trials
df <- gbd_dalys %>%
  inner_join(clinic_sum, by = c("cause" = "Condition_clean"))

## 4. Order cancers by DALYs (like the example figure) ----
df <- df %>%
  arrange(dalys) %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(cause, levels = cause))

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    dalys_mill = dalys / 1e6,       # DALYs → millions
    trials_k   = n_trials / 1e2   
  ) %>%
  arrange(dalys_mill) %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(cause, levels = cause))

plot_df <- df2 %>%
  select(cause, dalys_mill, trials_k) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -cause,
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value_signed = ifelse(metric == "dalys_mill", -value, value),
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      dalys_mill = "DALYs (millions)",
      trials_k   = "Trials (hundreds)"
    )
  )

p_bar <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = value_signed, y = cause, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty_breaks(10),
    labels = function(x) comma(abs(x), accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "DALYs (millions)" = "grey50",
      "Trials (hundreds)"   = "#1f78b4"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "DALYs vs clinical trial activity by cancer type"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position    = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

p_bar

ggsave("../Result/DALYs vs clinical trial bar.png",p_bar,    width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
standardize_country <- function(x) {
  x_utf8 <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8")
  x_low <- tolower(str_trim(x_utf8))
  case_when(
    x_low %in% c("united states", "united states of america", "usa", "u.s.a.") ~ "United States",
    x_low %in% c("united kingdom", "uk", "u.k.")                               ~ "United Kingdom",
    x_low %in% c("russian federation", "russia")                               ~ "Russia",
    x_low %in% c("iran (islamic republic of)", "iran")                         ~ "Iran",
    x_low %in% c("viet nam", "vietnam")                                        ~ "Vietnam",
    TRUE                                                                       ~ str_to_title(x_low)
  )
}
```



```{r}
SDI_calculated <- SDI %>%
  rename(
    country_sdi  = `Location Name`,
    SDI_value    = `2023 SDI Index Value`,
    SDI_quintile = `SDI Quintile`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SDI_quintile_new = case_when(
      SDI_value < 0.46 ~ "Low SDI",
      SDI_value < 0.59 ~ "Low-middle SDI",
      SDI_value < 0.69 ~ "Middle SDI",
      SDI_value < 0.78 ~ "High-middle SDI",
      SDI_value >= 0.78 ~ "High SDI",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SDI_quintile_final = ifelse(
      is.na(SDI_quintile),
      SDI_quintile_new,
      SDI_quintile
    ),
    country_std = standardize_country(country_sdi)
  ) %>%
  select(country_std, SDI_value, SDI_quintile_final)

```

```{r}

global_df <- global_df %>%
  mutate(
    mismatch = trial_share / burden_share,
    log2_mismatch = log2(mismatch)  # >0 = overrepresented; <0 = underrepresented
  )
```

```{r}
SDIClinic <- ggplot(global_df,
       aes(x = SDI_value, y = log2_mismatch,
           color = SDI_quintile_final, label = country_std)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +

  labs(
```

```{r}
China_dalys  <- China_latest %>% filter(measure == "DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years)")

China_inc    <- China_latest %>% filter(measure == "Incidence")
```

```{r}
china_dalys <- China %>%
  filter(
    sex == "Both",
    age == "All ages",
    metric == "Number",
    measure == "DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years)"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(dalys_china = val)

```

```{r}
trials_china <- clinic %>%
  filter(!is.na(Countries_clean)) %>%
  # keep trials that include China as one of the countries
  filter(str_detect(Countries_clean, "China")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition_clean)) %>%
  group_by(Condition_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials_china     = n_distinct(TrialID),
    total_target_china = sum(target_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

```{r}
china_burden_trials <- china_dalys %>%
  inner_join(trials_china,
             by = c("cause" = "Condition_clean")) %>%
  mutate(
    # shares among cancers within China
    burden_share = dalys_china / sum(dalys_china),
    trial_share  = n_trials_china / sum(n_trials_china),
    # log2 ratio: >0 = over-researched, <0 = under-researched
    log2_ratio   = log2(trial_share / burden_share),
    mismatch     = case_when(
      log2_ratio >  0 ~ "Over-represented in trials",
      log2_ratio <  0 ~ "Under-represented in trials",
      TRUE            ~ "Proportional"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(china_burden_trials,
       aes(x = burden_share, y = trial_share, label = cause)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = mismatch, size = n_trials_china), alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Under-represented in trials" = "red",
      "Over-represented in trials"  = "darkgreen",
      "Proportional"                = "grey40"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "China: Clinical trial activity vs DALY burden by cancer type",
    x = "Share of China cancer DALY burden",
    y = "Share of China cancer clinical trials (that include China)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

```{r}
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(color = mismatch), size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red","darkgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "China: Under- vs Over-Representation of Cancer Trials",
    x = "Imbalance (log2 ratio)",
    y = "Cancer type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
china_diverge <- china_burden_trials %>%
  mutate(
    burden_val = dalys_china / 1e6,       # China DALYs in millions
    trial_val  = n_trials_china/ 1e2
  ) %>%
  arrange(burden_val) %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(cause, levels = cause))

plot_df <- china_diverge %>%
  select(cause, burden_val, trial_val) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cause,
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    value_signed = ifelse(metric == "burden_val", -value, value),
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      burden_val = "DALYs (millions)",
      trial_val  = "Trials(hundreds)"
    )
  )

china <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = value_signed, y = cause, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = ~abs(.)) +
  labs(
    title = "China: DALYs vs Clinical Trials",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../Result/China: DALYs vs Clinical Trials.png",china,width = 15, height = 8, dpi = 600)

```
```{r}
library(fmsb)

library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# pick top 5 cancers by China DALY burden
china_top5 <- china_burden_trials %>%
  arrange(desc(dalys_china)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    burden_norm = burden_share / max(burden_share),
    trial_norm  = trial_share  / max(trial_share),
    mis_norm    = (trial_share / burden_share) / 
                  max(trial_share / burden_share)
  ) %>%
  select(cause, burden_norm, trial_norm, mis_norm)



```

```{r}
max_row <- data.frame(burden_norm = 1, trial_norm = 1, mis_norm = 1)
min_row <- data.frame(burden_norm = 0, trial_norm = 0, mis_norm = 0)

radar_df <- rbind(
  max_row,
  min_row,
  as.data.frame(china_top5[, -1])  # drop 'cause' column
)

rownames(radar_df) <- c("max", "min", china_top5$cause)
```

```{r}
radarchart(
  radar_df,
  axistype = 1,
  pcol = rainbow(nrow(radar_df) - 2),
  pfcol = scales::alpha(rainbow(nrow(radar_df) - 2), 0.3),
  plwd = 2,
  cglcol = "grey",
  cglty = 1,
  axislabcol = "grey20",
  caxislabels = c("0", "0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1"),
  cglwd = 0.8,
  vlcex = 0.8
)
legend("topright",
       legend = china_top5$cause,
       col = rainbow(nrow(radar_df) - 2),
       pch = 15,
       bty = "n",
       cex = 0.7)
```
